look_here_first: Inspect the stem immediately below each petiole for a small spinelike tubercle, then confirm an erect plant with toothed leaves and small yellow axillary flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is the currently locked target-zone voucher county. Broader Texas nativity is supported, but the project three-county native-certification threshold is not yet met.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Range unresolved does not block learner use; exclude from confirmed-native metrics until later evidence changes the label.

best_field_traits: ovate to lanceolate leaves serrate toward the base
small spinelike tubercle often present below petiole
morphology_keys.comparison_training: S. abutilifolia sprawls along the ground; S. spinosa is erect and often shows the petiole-base tubercle.
